hotspots.title: Hungarian Orban Ex-Minister Buried Cash Corruption Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian opposition leader Péter Magyar and government figures remain embroiled in fallout from an ongoing bribery investigation into former minister Miklós Seszták, where authorities unearthed millions in buried cash. Fidesz figures have attempted to distance themselves from Seszták and demand his resignation, while Magyar describes the case as proof of a collapsing mafia regime.
hotspots.affect: Commands white-hot attention due to shocking physical evidence of corruption—millions in cash buried in forests—and high-stakes political panic within Orbán's ruling coalition.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Santiago Abascal and Vox leadership have escalated their campaign rhetoric ahead of the November 29 elections, holding high-capacity rallies across Spain. Abascal has targeted Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez as a 'mafia leader' while demanding historic mobilization against immigration and calling for a defense of Spanish sovereignty.
hotspots.affect: Generates intense affective investment through apocalyptic campaign framing, stark cultural grievances, and aggressive anti-government rhetoric.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: President Javier Milei officially confirmed he will seek a second presidential term in 2027, promising massive tax returns to taxpayers by 2031. The declaration has sharpened internal friction within La Libertad Avanza and its alliance with Patricia Bullrich and Mauricio Macri as opposition leaders challenge his economic record.
hotspots.affect: Commands high attention due to early reelection posturing, aggressive fiscal promises, and escalating internal power struggles within Argentina's right-wing coalition.

hotspots.title: Macron-Le Pen Clash Over Ukraine Aid & 2027
hotspots.blurb: French President Emmanuel Macron and his allies launched a scathing political attack against Marine Le Pen, warning that her proposal to cut financial support for Ukraine is unpatriotic and would isolate France in Europe. Le Pen retaliated by attacking Macron's domestic record while new 2027 presidential polling continues to show her leading the field.
hotspots.affect: Commands strong focus due to high-stakes foreign policy clashes coupled with early national maneuvering for the upcoming French presidential election.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) drew widespread media attention and criticism by nominating former 1990 World Cup football star Thomas Berthold as its candidate for German President. Political opponents and commentators have condemned the nomination, emphasizing Berthold's history of promoting conspiracy theories.
hotspots.affect: Drives polarized debate and media reaction by combining sports celebrity nostalgia with radical political strategy and conspiracy theory controversies.
